auth.signInBody: Sign in when you are ready to participate. Browsing stays open to everyone.
auth.signUpBody: Create an account to save, message, publish, or begin a transaction.
auth.legal: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and acknowledge the <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.body: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.
verify.resent: A new verification email was sent.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.body: Enter the email address attached to your account.
recovery.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a password reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: This link must be opened from the password reset email.

errors.confirmation_failed: That confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one and try again.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Verify your email before signing in.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.link_expired: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts were made. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unknown: We could not complete that request. Please try again.
errors.already_registered: An account with this email already exists. Sign in or reset your password instead.

notices.password_updated: Your password was updated. Sign in with the new password.

auth.ageConfirmation: I confirm I am at least 18 years old.

consent.label: Analytics choice
consent.body: Help us improve Scrlpets with optional analytics. We do not start analytics until you accept. Read the <privacy>Privacy Notice</privacy>.

feed.listingContext: Structured for seller context and animal details.
feed.productContext: Care products and recommendations will live here.
feed.followingEmptyBody: Follow people to fill this feed, or switch to For You to discover more.

content.lockedAttributionBody: Posting identity and subject stay fixed after publishing.
content.deletePostBody: This post will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
content.removeListingBody: The listing will disappear from Scrlpets but remain preserved for marketplace integrity.
content.deleteError: We couldn't remove this content. Try again.

brandAccess.label: Operators
brandAccess.title: Brand members
brandAccess.addBody: Enter their exact username. Access starts immediately.
brandAccess.ownerProtected: The primary owner cannot be removed or demoted.

errors.profile_not_found: No Scrlpets profile has that exact username.
errors.duplicate_member: That person already belongs to this brand.
errors.brand_permission_denied: Your role cannot make that change.
errors.unknown: We couldn't update brand access. Try again.

brandAccess.restrictTitle: Who can post as this brand
brandAccess.restrictBody: Restrict posting to admins and owners. Contributors keep managing their own content.
brandAccess.restrictError: Could not update the setting. Try again.

profile.blockedNote: You blocked this user. You won't see their content or exchange messages.

detail.postDetailBody: This is the social post context. Comments and reactions build here without changing the feed contract.
detail.reelDetailBody: This is the short-form destination. A full immersive player can replace this shell later.
detail.videoDetailBody: This is the long-form watch surface for YouTube-style playback, chapters, and time-aware comments later.
detail.listingDetailBody: This is the litter/listing destination where trust, records, seller context, and purchase flow mature in the marketplace phase.
detail.productDetailBody: This is the shop/product destination for future breeder-recommended care products and promos.
detail.listingActivity: View listing activity for this animal
detail.listingSummaryBody: This surface is prepared for animal details, seller context, and marketplace trust signals as those features mature.
detail.productSummaryBody: This surface is prepared for care products, seller recommendations, and shop paths without implying checkout yet.

marketplace.label: Marketplace inquiry
marketplace.evidenceBody: Starting a conversation saves the listing title, price, animal, seller, and time. Scrlpets does not process payments for this listing yet.
marketplace.operatorState: You operate this listing. Buyer inquiries will appear in Messages.

errors.listing_unavailable: This listing is no longer available.
errors.self_inquiry: Listing operators cannot start a buyer inquiry.
errors.auth_required: Sign in to ask about this listing.
errors.inquiry_failed: The conversation could not be opened. Please try again.
